execute(uint256).details: Ensures execution succeeds but ignores return data.

params.proposalId: the id of the proposal to execute.

params.proposalData: ABI encoded data containing the function signature and parameters to be         executed as part of this proposal.
params.targets: the target contracts to execute the proposalData on.

params.newCoolingOff: the new cooling off period in seconds.

params.newWarmup: the new warming up period in seconds.

stake(uint96).details: requires users to have approved this contract to transfer their      governance tokens.

params.amount: the amount of governance tokens to stake.
the amount of governance tokens to vote on this proposal with.
params.proposalId: the id of the proposal to be voted on.
params.userVote: the vote on this proposal. True for yes, False for no.

params.amount: the amount of governance tokens to withdraw.

getStaked(address).notice: Gets the total amount staked by a given user.

propose(address[],bytes[]).notice: Proposes a function execution on a contract by the governance contract.

setCoolingOff(uint32).notice: Sets the cooling off period for proposals.

setMaxProposalTargets(uint32).notice: Sets the maximum number of targets that a proposal can execute.

setProposalThreshold(uint96).notice: Sets the minimum number of tokens to be staked for proposing.

setQuorumDivisor(uint8).notice: Sets the amount to divide the totalStaked by to see if quorum is reached.For example, quorumDivisor = 2 means if yes votes >= totalStaked / 2, proposal has passed.

setWarmUp(uint32).notice: Sets the warming up period for proposals.

stake(uint96).notice: Stakes governance tokens allowing users voting rights.

vote(uint256,bool,uint96).notice: Allows a staker to vote on a given proposal. A staker may vote multiple times, and vote on either or both sides. A vote may not be revoked once made.

withdraw(uint96).notice: Withdraws from a given users stake.
